transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good evening, thank you for calling S-Net TV and Broadband Support, my name is Lewis, how can I help you tonight?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: hi lewis my name is barnaby and my s-net ultra pvr television box has completely stopped letting me record anything it keeps popping up hard drive storage error two zero two

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Oh Barnaby, I am so sorry you are getting hit with Hard Drive Storage Error 202 on your Ultra PVR box—I completely understand how frustrating it is when your recorder fails and you risk missing your shows!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yeah tell me about it it failed right in the middle of the champions league quarter final last night and missed my wifes drama series too

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Missing the Champions League quarter-final and your wife's drama series is the absolute worst timing, Barnaby, I am really sorry about that. Let me get your account open so I can fix this right now.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: thanks lewis what do you need from me to find the account

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could you just give me your eight-digit S-Net account number from the top of your bill and your date of birth, Barnaby?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: sure the account number is 88412095 and my date of birth is the nineteenth of may nineteen seventy-eight

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Brilliant, thank you Barnaby, I have your profile open right here and I can see your S-Net Ultra 2TB v3 PVR box online.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: great and look i have about forty films and old rugby matches saved on that box that i really do not want to wipe if we can help it

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do not worry at all, Barnaby, I am not going to run a full factory format that wipes your forty films and rugby matches—we are going to use the non-destructive partition table rebuild instead.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: oh thank goodness for that because the error message on the telly screen kept telling me to format the disk

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, the on-screen banner always suggests a full wipe, Barnaby, but Error 202 is actually just a corrupted EXT4 recording journal index that we can repair from the hidden engineer menu.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay i have the s-net voice remote in my hand right in front of the television now

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Fantastic. First, press the Home button on your S-Net remote so the main main-menu ribbon appears along the bottom of your screen, Barnaby.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yep pressed home and the bottom menu bar is up

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now arrow all the way down to Settings at the bottom left, highlight it, but do not press Select yet—just leave the highlight bar sitting on Settings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay i have highlighted settings without pressing select

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now, while Settings is highlighted, press Zero, Zero, One on the number pad of your remote control, and then press the centre Select button right after, Barnaby.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: zero zero one select... oh wow a secret dark blue installer setup menu just opened up on the screen

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Spot on, Barnaby! That is the hidden S-Net engineer menu. You should see five tabs down the left-hand column starting with Network, Transponders, and Hard Disk.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yes i see network transponders hard disk apps and reset

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Arrow down to the third tab labeled Hard Disk, and then press the right arrow once to move into the disk management options.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay i am inside the hard disk column now and there are three options

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Make sure you highlight the first option, which says 'Rebuild Partition Table & Journal Index (Keep Recordings)', and definitely stay away from the third option that says 'Full Disk Wipe'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yes i am triple checking that it definitely says rebuild partition table and journal index keep recordings

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, Barnaby. Press the centre Select button once on 'Rebuild Partition Table & Journal Index', and then press the green button on your remote when the confirmation box pops up.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: pressed select and pressed the green button... now the screen has gone black with a white progress bar saying checking ext4 storage blocks stage one of three

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is exactly what we want to see. The Ultra PVR box is now scanning the two-terabyte drive, isolating any bad sector blocks, and unlocking the read-only recording journal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: how long does this three stage disk rebuild take to finish

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It usually takes around fifty to sixty seconds to complete all three stages and reboot the PVR daemon, Barnaby. While the box is running that check, I also need to refresh your cloud series-link token from my terminal.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay sounds good

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: May I place you on a brief hold for about a minute while your Ultra PVR box finishes the three-stage partition rebuild and I push the TR-069 series-link sync from the headend, Barnaby?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yeah of course lewis take your time

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Barnaby! From my diagnostic console here, I can see your S-Net Ultra PVR box just re-established its TR-069 management heartbeat after the reboot, and I have pushed the cloud series-link sync.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: yes the television screen just came back onto live bbc one hd a few seconds ago

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Awesome! Look at the telemetry report that just uploaded from your box—it found and remapped two corrupted journal inodes from last night's power spike without touching a single video file.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: let me check my saved recordings first to make sure my forty films and rugby matches are still there

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press the Recordings button right above the directional pad on your remote, Barnaby, and check your 'Saved & Manage' tab.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: pressing recordings now... yes every single one of my forty films and the six nations rugby matches are still sitting there and it says forty-two percent disk space used

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That is a massive relief, Barnaby! Now check the 'Scheduled' tab right next to it so we can be sure my TR-069 push restored your wife's drama series links.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: moving across to scheduled... yes all eleven series links with the little double-arrow icon are back in the planner for tonight and tomorrow

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Brilliant. Now let's do the real test together while we are on the line, Barnaby, to prove that Hard Drive Storage Error 202 is completely gone.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: good idea what should i do

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Press Exit to go back to live BBC One HD, and then press the round red Record button at the top of your remote control.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay i am back on bbc one hd and pressing the red record button now...

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Tell me what happens on the front panel of the Ultra PVR box and on the top right of your television screen, Barnaby.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: no error 202 popup at all the little red r circle just lit up on the front of the box and the banner says recording the one show on bbc one hd

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes! Let it record for about ten seconds so it writes a full video segment onto the newly rebuilt EXT4 partition, Barnaby.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: okay counting to ten... right that has been about twelve seconds now

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Now press the Recordings button, click onto 'The One Show (Recording Now)', and press Play from Start to make sure the drive reads the new recording back smoothly.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: clicking play from start... yep it is playing back the clip we just recorded with crystal clear sound and picture and no stuttering at all

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And try pressing the Pause button on that live recording for two seconds and then Play again, Barnaby, just to verify the time-shift buffer partition is healthy too.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: paused it... and pressed play again works like a charm lewis

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Awesome! And while you have that test recording playing, Barnaby, try pressing the Fast Forward button twice to test two-times and six-times trick-play indexing on the hard drive.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: pressing fast forward... yep it scrubs smoothly forward through the clip and drops straight back into normal play when i press play

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That proves the EXT4 seek table on your two-terabyte drive is completely healthy and has zero physical read-head latency.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: what actually caused the journal index to corrupt last night in the first place lewis

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Looking at your box diagnostic log, there was a brief mains voltage dip at 21:42 last night while two HD tuners were writing simultaneously during the football match.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: ah yes our kitchen lights did flicker for a split second during the thunderstorm last night

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That split-second brownout interrupted an active inode commit, so the Ultra PVR locked the partition into read-only safety mode and threw Error 202 to protect your existing recordings.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: that actually makes a lot of sense at least it protected my saved films rather than corrupting the whole drive

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Also, while we are testing, press the Channel Up button once to switch to BBC Two HD while BBC One HD is still recording in the background, Barnaby.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: switched to bbc two hd and both channels are working fine with the red r light still steady on the front panel

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms both satellite and cable DVB tuners are writing concurrently to the rebuilt partition without any buffer conflict.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: brilliant that is a huge weight off my mind

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also enabled the 'Auto-Heal File System on Standby' flag on your box firmware profile from my console so if a minor index glitch ever happens overnight at 3 AM, the box repairs it silently.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: oh that is clever so it wont interrupt an evening recording with error 202 again

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly, Barnaby. You can delete that short test clip of The One Show whenever you like by pressing the yellow button in your Recordings list.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: just pressed yellow and deleted the test clip so my planner is nice and tidy

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am so glad we got your S-Net Ultra PVR recording smoothly again and kept all forty of your saved films and rugby matches safe, Barnaby.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: honestly you have saved my evening lewis my wife would have killed me if her drama series tonight didn't record

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Haha, I am very happy to have kept you out of trouble tonight, Barnaby! Is there anything else I can help you with on your TV or broadband package?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: no everything else is spot on thanks so much for walking me through that secret menu

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: It was an absolute pleasure helping you tonight, Barnaby. Thank you for choosing S-Net, and enjoy your shows this evening!

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: cheers lewis have a good night bye

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Barnaby, goodbye!
